Question: Asslamu aleykum, I was reading a fatwa that said that Allmaha Al?? ad-D?n al-Haskaf? writes in ad-Durr al-Mukht?r that singing without music is haraam. I want to know what about Anasheeds? What about the singing of the Qasida Burda? If the following two are allowed can you please tell us what are the requirements for it something to be allowed to sing? Jazakallah khair Answer ID: 3359 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 291/267=B) Anasheed (poems of qaseedah, naat, and hamd) which do not contain a lie, nonsense and unlawful, can be recited with the conditions: (1) there is no music (2) there is no fear of any evil (3) it is not recited by a woman or an adolescent boy. (4) It does not interfere in any ones slalah and zikr. In short, it must be free from unlawful things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
